verdict.rationale: Running local LLMs is a fair question for a desktop CPU platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never states maximum supported memory capacity, memory channels, or published memory bandwidth, and it never mentions running a 70B-class model. The only nearby items are EXPO memory overclocking, DDR5 tuning, AVX-512 support and generic "AI experiences" marketing, none of which shows that 70B quantized inference is practical.
